input_sources: data/extracted/*/*_BIF_*.csv (one file per site, resolved via fluxnet::flux_discover_files())
notes: TowerTango card table. card_year_established via compute_site_year_presence() on monthly FLUXMET; card_sink_strength_nep_gC_m2_yr/card_et_* via compute_site_annual_fluxes() (VUT with CUT fallback, QC_THRESHOLD_YY=0.5); card_tower_height_m is a best-effort free-text regex extraction (no structured field exists in this BIF export -- see README.md); card_canopy_height_max_m/_date/_n_records from the structured HEIGHTC BADM field (GRP_HEIGHTC/HEIGHTC, plus JP-Shn's own non-standard VARIABLE_GROUP value -- see README.md), maximum value across all of a site's dated records; card_map_mm_yr/card_mat_degC from site_worldclim.csv with a local-raster fallback for any site missing from it. Snapshot: fluxnet_shuttle_snapshot_20260920T102211.csv.
